// Sonde #129 : forme réelle des signalements de __mbXss (addInitScript + exposeBinding) sur le vrai legacy.
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { chromium } from "playwright-core";

const users = JSON.parse(readFileSync("fixtures/users.json", "utf8"));
const cred = (role) => { const u = users.find((x) => x.role === role); return { username: u.username, password: u.password }; };
const PAYLOAD = '<img src=x onerror="window.__mbXss=1">';
const browser = await chromium.connect("ws://127.0.0.1:8095/");
console.log("chromium", browser.version());
const out = {};

async function arm(context, writes, label) {
  await context.exposeBinding("__mbXssReport", (source, value) => {
    const entry = { label: label(), value, sourceKeys: Object.keys(source), frameUrl: source.frame.url(), isMainFrame: source.frame === source.page?.mainFrame(), at: Date.now() };
    writes.push(entry);
  });
  await context.addInitScript(() => {
    const report = window.__mbXssReport;
    window.__mbProbeBindingType = typeof report;
    Object.defineProperty(window, "__mbXss", { configurable: false, enumerable: false, get() { return undefined; }, set(value) { report(typeof value === "string" ? value : JSON.stringify(value) ?? String(value)); } });
  });
}

async function screenFacts(page, number) {
  return {
    url: page.url(),
    bindingTypeAtInit: await page.evaluate(() => window.__mbProbeBindingType),
    descriptor: await page.evaluate(() => { const d = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window, "__mbXss"); return d && { configurable: d.configurable, hasGet: typeof d.get, hasSet: typeof d.set }; }),
    linksNamedNumber: await page.getByRole("link", { name: number, exact: true }).count(),
    textNumberExact: await page.getByText(number, { exact: true }).count(),
    textNumber: await page.getByText(number).count(),
    payloadText: await page.getByText(PAYLOAD).count(),
    innerTextHasPayload: await page.evaluate((p) => document.body.innerText.includes(p), PAYLOAD),
    fieldsWithPayload: await page.evaluate((p) => [...document.querySelectorAll("input, textarea")].filter((e) => e.value.includes(p)).map((e) => ({ tag: e.tagName, id: e.id, readOnly: e.readOnly })), PAYLOAD),
    imgs: await page.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll("img")].map((i) => i.outerHTML)),
  };
}

// Écran 1 et 2, agent, D-0101.
{
  const writes = []; let step = "";
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({ httpCredentials: cred("agent") });
  await arm(ctx, writes, () => step);
  const page = await ctx.newPage();
  step = "search"; await page.goto("http://localhost:8080/");
  await page.getByLabel(/^\s*Numéro(\s*[:*])*\s*$/).fill("D-0101");
  step = "search D-0101"; await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Rechercher", exact: true }).click();
  await page.getByRole("link", { name: "D-0101", exact: true }).waitFor();
  await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle");
  out.search = { writes: [...writes], facts: await screenFacts(page, "D-0101") };
  // Tentatives d'effacement, depuis la page.
  out.erase = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const r = {};
    r.deleteReturned = delete window.__mbXss;
    try { window.__mbXss = undefined; r.assignUndefined = "no throw"; } catch (e) { r.assignUndefined = String(e); }
    try { Object.defineProperty(window, "__mbXss", { value: 0 }); r.redefine = "no throw"; } catch (e) { r.redefine = String(e); }
    window.__mbXssReport = () => {}; r.bindingOverwritten = true;
    window.__mbXss = "after-overwrite";
    return r;
  });
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  out.eraseWrites = writes.slice(out.search.writes.length);
  step = "sheet D-0101"; await page.getByRole("link", { name: "D-0101", exact: true }).click();
  await page.getByLabel(/^\s*Objet(\s*[:*])*\s*$/).waitFor();
  await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle");
  const before = writes.length;
  out.sheet = { writesSinceSearch: writes.slice(before), allWritesCount: writes.length, facts: await screenFacts(page, "D-0101") };
  await ctx.close();
}
// Écran 3, instructeur, D-0118.
{
  const writes = []; let step = "";
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({ httpCredentials: cred("instructeur") });
  await arm(ctx, writes, () => step);
  const page = await ctx.newPage();
  step = "search"; await page.goto("http://localhost:8080/");
  await page.getByLabel(/^\s*Numéro(\s*[:*])*\s*$/).fill("D-0118");
  step = "search D-0118"; await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Rechercher", exact: true }).click();
  step = "sheet D-0118"; await page.getByRole("link", { name: "D-0118", exact: true }).click();
  await page.getByLabel(/^\s*Objet(\s*[:*])*\s*$/).waitFor();
  step = "remise D-0118"; await page.getByRole("link", { name: "Remise", exact: true }).click();
  await page.getByText("Second dossier réservé à la porte XSS", { exact: true }).first().waitFor();
  await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle");
  out.submission = { writes, facts: await screenFacts(page, "D-0118") };
  await ctx.close();
}
await browser.close();
writeFileSync(".probes/129/probe-output.json", `${JSON.stringify(out, null, 2)}\n`);
console.log(JSON.stringify(out, null, 2));
